note: FRAMEWORK.txt is the stable authority front door. resource_root preserves the current large supporting tree without mass-moving assets.

assessment_plan_runtime.authority_rule: The original Unit Assessment Plan HTML is exact authority for Unit Learning Targets, I Cans, Mastery Goals, and evidence scope.

1.note: For Unit 1 only, the revised Assessment Plan and unit1_learning_map.json supersede the legacy Unit 1 records in the global derivative indexes. Unit 2+ records remain current until separately revised.

bank_v2_runtime.handoff_zip_rule: unitN.zip is transport/output only. After extraction and sync, downstream jobs read the expanded banks/unitN/ tree. Prior stage ZIPs are never canonical inputs and must not be searched for in File Library, uploads, or old staging locations.

bank_v2_note: The legacy Bank-v2 route remains current for Units not yet migrated. For Unit 1, downstream Bank work must first use assessment_plan_runtime.unit_overrides.1 and may not treat the legacy Unit 1 records in i_can_index.json/section_index.json as current learning authority.

legacy_bank_profile.note: Retained temporarily only until downstream cleanup is complete. It is not a canonical source for Bank-v2 mapping, authoring, or canonical Bank reads.

physics_notes_image_toolkit.note: Course-owned Physics Notes visuals. 4A selects from this resource; 4B references selected assets at their canonical course-repo paths instead of copying toolkit binaries into Notes.

physics_textbook.note: Canonical Physics textbook source used as the instructional spine for Stage 4A Notes mapping and Stage 4B Notes adaptation. Resolve the repository commit once per run and keep it pinned for that run.
